known_limitations: The primary universe measures US equity-sector structure, not cross-asset structure.
Research portfolios are not directly investable instruments.
The provider may revise full history; point-in-time vintages begin with the locally archived approval vintage.
No standalone Swedish equity, emerging-market equity, rates, credit, commodity, gold or SEK basket channel is present in v1.
This universe may support unsupervised PH research, but supervised production promotion still needs a licensed and frozen target series.
